messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — vendors bumped a couple regional ETAs. We need a contingency plan for the marketplace announce so comms doesn't flip the press queue.
Derek (Partnerships): Can you summarize which SKUs/regions moved?
NVIDIA - Chen: H100/H200 NA allocation delayed ~6 days. APAC unaffected. No firmware issues. We request a 48h pre-brief.
AMD - Lucia: MI300 carriers hit a sorter delay, ETA +5 days. We did ship a small thermal microcode today but it passed our tests.
SI - Nova: Integrators asked for an optional extra-week validation before we open managed onboarding. They prefer SI GA 10 days after public.
Infra - Omar: Technical impact: we need to regen Gaudi optimized kernels (~24h) and run a regional canary (~36h) if we accept new firmware. Current canary snapshot:
```
base-image: rwd-22.04-gpu:2026-03-15
kernel: 6.1.60
cuda: 12.2
rocm: 5.8
model-optimizer: 3.2.2
```
Infra - Omar: If partners hold dates, we can still publish a soft-window. If they want firm dates in copy, infra needs green canary 48h before public.
Comms - Zoe: Marketing preference: single public announce with a "soft availability window" + region callouts. Keeps the press run clean. We also want partner quotes by EOD tomorrow.
Legal - Rita: We'll prep two copy variants: soft-window and firm-date. Partners must approve quotes; legal needs ~24h review. Tag us on the asset doc.
Priya (PM): Proposed cadence:
- Day 0: partner pre-brief + handoff assets (48h before publish)
- Day 1: infra kernel regen + start canaries (NA/EU parallel)
- Day 3: partner + legal signoff on copy
- Day 4: marketplace publish (gated on canary green)
- Day 14: SI GA (optional stagger for integrators)
NVIDIA - Chen: Sounds good. Please mark perf bullets as "preliminary" and avoid firm inventory promises.
AMD - Lucia: If our sorter fix slips into Day 1, expect a +1 week on enablement. We'll update ASAP.
Infra - Omar: Spun up 3-node canary (2 NA, 1 EU). Telemetry prefix: s3://redwood/partnerships/3250000000/canary/
ops-bot: Canary job started: canary-3250000000 -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/3250000000/logs
Infra - Omar: Early kernel regen completed for Gaudi; running perf baselines now.
ops-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS, artifacts -> s3://redwood/partnerships/3250000000/artifacts.tgz
Infra - Omar: Canary PASS. No regressions. B200 thermal delta +2% peak, within SLO. Uploading metrics to s3.
Comms - Zoe: I'll draft soft-window copy now and a firm-date variant if partners confirm inventory. Will share drafts in the doc and tag Legal.
Legal - Rita: On it. We'll prioritize soft-window so press isn't blocked.
Derek (Partnerships): Action items: Omar post full metrics; Zoe circulate soft-window first; Priya run partner confirmation call 11am PT tomorrow; Legal watch the asset PR.
NVIDIA - Chen: Will join the 11am call.
AMD - Lucia: Oncall too.
SI - Nova: We'll plan for SI GA Day 14 and request image handoff Day 6 for integrator validation.
Priya (PM): Thanks team — decision: proceed with soft-window public announce gated on canary green; SI GA to be staggered Day 14. If partners push any red flags, we hold and keep press copy non-dated. :white_check_mark:
